plain.li: [notice:growth] Every plant out there is leaning toward the same tree.
[notice:growth] The leaves are drifting all one way, and there isn't a breath of wind.
[notice:growth] Look at the field, I swear it's grown since this morning.
[notice:growth,named] {GOD} is listening, so mind what you cut today.
[notice:growth,named] {GOD} is near, everything green is turned to her.
[notice:growth,scoffer] Plants lean to the light, that's all this is.
[axe] That felt wrong, like I was cutting into something awake.
[axe] The whole tree shuddered before it went, I didn't like it.
[axe,named] {GOD} won't forget that one, I could feel it.
[notice:warmstone] The rock's warm to the touch, like something's breathing in it.
[notice:warmstone] There's steam coming out of the cracks at the foot of the rock.
[notice:warmstone] Ash is falling, fine as flour, and the stone is warm.
[notice:warmstone,named] {GOD} is breathing under us, can you feel the floor?
[notice:warmstone,scoffer] Warm rock and a bit of steam, the ground does that.
[notice:grazing] The deer are lying down right next to it, they're not afraid at all.
[notice:grazing] Nothing out there is running from anything today.
[notice:grazing] I was going to shout at someone, and I just couldn't be bothered.
[notice:grazing,named] Let {GOD} pass, and be quiet while he does.
[notice:grazing,scoffer] A big tame beast and a lot of calm animals, nothing more.
[notice:rot] There are spores on the air, pale little things, everywhere.
[notice:rot] Mushrooms came up in a ring overnight, and the meat's already turning.
[notice:rot] Everything smells of wet earth today, even indoors.
[notice:rot,named] {GOD} is close, get the food into the cold.
[notice:rot,scoffer] Damp weather, mushrooms, rot, it happens every year.
[notice:warmth] The fire's been burning all evening and hardly needed a log.
[notice:warmth] It feels like a festival night, and nobody planned one.
[notice:warmth] Even the dogs are following our guest about.
[notice:warmth,named] {GOD} is under our roof, so make the welcome good.
[notice:warmth,scoffer] A warm night and a good fire, I won't argue with that.
[notice:hum] The lights are pulsing, slow and steady, like something breathing.
[notice:hum] Can you hear the wires humming to themselves?
[notice:hum] The batteries haven't dropped all day, how is that?
[notice:hum,named] {GOD} is awake in the wires, I'd say hello.
[notice:hum,scoffer] A loose connection makes lights do that, someone check it.
[prank] This door won't open for me, it opens for everyone else.
[prank] I can't get this door to budge, and it's not even locked.
[prank] The door's stuck, but only when I try it, I swear.
[prank,named] Very funny, {GOD}, now let me through.
[prankend] There, now it opens, of course it does.
[prankend] Somebody else opens it and it's fine, unbelievable.
[notice:highsky] The sky's never looked that high before.
[notice:highsky] Lightning over the hills, and not a drop of rain here.
[notice:highsky] Every bird is gone, and the sky is perfectly clear.
[notice:highsky,named] {GOD} is looking down today, I can feel it.
[notice:highsky,scoffer] Clear weather and dry lightning far off, that's all.
[notice:whitesilence] Nobody said a word for hours, and nobody could say why.
[notice:whitesilence] That silence was cold, and the frost is still on the walls.
[notice:whitesilence,named] {GOD} came close, and none of us could speak.
[notice:whitesilence,scoffer] A cold quiet spell, people get like that in winter.
[notice:dark] That corner stays dark, whatever we light there.
[notice:dark] The lamps aren't reaching as far as they should.
[notice:dark] The dark's thicker tonight, I don't like it.
[notice:dark,scoffer] Bad lamps and a long night, nothing more to it.
[whisper] Someone's talking to me in the dark, so sweet and so reasonable.
[whisper] I keep hearing a kind voice saying it can make everything better.
[whisper] It knows what I want, it said so, and it sounded kind.
[notice:longnoon] The sun hasn't moved in hours, look at the shadows.
[notice:longnoon] It's too bright and too hot, and it should be later than this.
[notice:longnoon] The panels are giving more than they ever have.
[notice:longnoon,named] {GOD} is staring down, and he won't look away.
[notice:longnoon,scoffer] A long hot day, the kind we get in summer.
[notice:moonsleep] The moon's so close you could read by it.
[notice:moonsleep] It's as light as dusk out here, at this hour.
[notice:moonsleep] Everyone's sleeping so deeply tonight, under that moon.
[notice:moonsleep,named] {GOD} is watching tonight, sleep well under her.
[notice:moonsleep,scoffer] A big moon, a bright night, sleep while you can.
[notice:rain] Something's croaking down in the well, and rain's coming.
[notice:rain] There are frogs everywhere on the wet ground all of a sudden.
[notice:rain] Water's standing by the well, and the air smells of rain.
[notice:rain,named] {GOD} is singing, the rain won't be long.
[notice:rain,scoffer] Frogs and rain, that's spring for you.
[croak] Did you feel that croak, deep in your chest?
[croak] Something old croaked down in the water just now.
[croak,named] That's {GOD} again, down in the wells.
[notice:glint] There's a glint in the stores every time I look away.
[notice:glint] A few coins have wandered off toward the edge of the land.
[notice:glint] A gold beetle just crossed the table and vanished.
[notice:glint,named] {GOD} is going by, so trade while it lasts.
[notice:glint,scoffer] Someone dropped some coins, there's nothing more to it.
[notice:watch] Every cat on the place is sitting with the graves.
[notice:watch] The rats are gone, all of them, overnight.
[notice:watch] The graves smell of warm stone and resin.
[notice:watch,named] {GOD} keeps the watch, so the dead are safe.
[notice:watch,scoffer] Cats like graves, they're warm and quiet.
[warmvoice] I dreamed a warm voice under the rock, very patient, asking what I'd give.
[warmvoice] Something deep in the mountain talked to me all night, warm as a hearth.
[warmvoice] I dreamed of gold in the dark and a voice that knew my name.
[true:raid] I dreamed of blades at the walls, so we'd best be ready.
[true:raid] I saw strangers with weapons coming to the gate in my dream.
[true:visitors] I dreamed a stranger came up the road with a full pack.
[true:visitors] Someone's coming to visit, I saw them on the road in my sleep.
[true:predator] I dreamed of a {BEAST} in the long grass {SITE}, watching us.
[true:predator] There's teeth out {SITE}, I saw them in my dream.
[true:rot] I dreamed the stores were going soft, someone check the food.
[true:rot] In my dream the food was rotting where it sat.
[true:sad] I dreamed {OTHER} was crying where nobody could see.
[true:sad] Someone should sit with {OTHER}, I dreamed of them all night.
[true:moon] I dreamed the moon came down and sat with me a while.
[true:moon] I dreamed of silver water, and nothing bad at all.
[way:sapling,!scoffer] A young tree where the gift was, {GOD} took it into the ground.
[way:sapling,!scoffer] It's gone, and look, a sapling in its place.
[way:sapling,scoffer] A seed in the dirt and some rain, that's your sapling.
[way:crack,!scoffer] It's gone down the crack, and the floor's still warm.
[way:crack,!scoffer] Feel the stone, {GOD} took it down into the deep.
[way:crack,scoffer] It rolled down a crack, and the rock's warm from the sun.
[way:grazed,!scoffer] Grazed clean, and that hoofprint is bigger than my hand.
[way:grazed,!scoffer] Something huge was here in the night and ate it gently.
[way:grazed,scoffer] A deer had it, and stood in the mud doing it.
[way:rot,!scoffer] It's gone back to the earth, {GOD} took it as she takes everything.
[way:rot,!scoffer] Black soil and a mushroom, where the gift was yesterday.
[way:rot,scoffer] It rotted, that's what food does if you leave it out.
[way:guest,!scoffer] Footprints in, and none out, so someone came for it.
[way:guest,!scoffer] A guest took it in the night, and walked nowhere after.
[way:guest,scoffer] Someone walked in and took it, and walked out on the path.
[way:mended,!scoffer] The part's gone, and the broken one's running again.
[way:mended,!scoffer] {GOD} took the part and fixed the machine with it.
[way:mended,scoffer] Someone fixed that machine in the night and won't own up.
[way:takenup,!scoffer] It went up in the night, I saw the light go.
[way:takenup,!scoffer] Taken up into the sky, the place is empty under the stars.
[way:takenup,scoffer] A shooting star and a thief, both on the same night.
[way:frost,!scoffer] Frost all over the place where it was, and the gift gone.
[way:frost,!scoffer] {GOD} frosted it over and took it at dawn.
[way:frost,scoffer] A hard frost and a hungry fox, that's all.
[way:hunger,!scoffer] It's gone, and something else of ours is gone with it.
[way:hunger,!scoffer] It always takes more than it's given, I said it would.
[way:hunger,scoffer] We've got a thief, and they're not even careful.
[way:moon,!scoffer] It went under the moon, the place still has a silver look.
[way:moon,!scoffer] {GOD} showed her face and took the silver.
[way:moon,scoffer] A moonlit thief, very poetic, and our silver's gone.
[way:well,!scoffer] It went down into the water, I heard the croak.
[way:well,!scoffer] {GOD} took it down into the well, and sang after.
[way:well,scoffer] Someone threw it in the well, and a frog complained.
[way:cat,!scoffer] A cat had it at dawn, that's how she takes it.
[way:cat,!scoffer] Paw prints all around it, {GOD} sent her cats.
[way:cat,scoffer] The cats ate it, cats eat everything.
[way:given,visitor] This is for me, truly, from your shrine?
[way:given,visitor] I'll carry it on, as you say, and pass it to someone else.
[way:given,visitor] Gold given to a stranger, your people are odd and kind.
